EmailWorkers__Config.EmailWorkers__Config__Description: Send Email (the Internal tab): the ValeVision 3D API sends it (api/email/send, Microsoft Graph, the credentials in the server's secrets file) as the signed-in user, to Vale addresses only, 30 an hour. The address book is the users register (api/email/contacts). The External tab's client email goes to clients (93__Feature__ClientLinks, since v2.79.0).
